title: The Wizard publish runs headlessly: a Theme Kit gives a served website with a join page on its own theme
detail: SYS-8 probe, website half. For every Theme Kit, publishStarterSite writes a website that the public gate (publishedWebsiteSnapshot) serves under the site style applyMegaTheme wrote, with a home page and the join page, on the Space's own theme. Still open under SYS-8: the themed welcome email (SYS-17) is not built, so this probe does not cover it.

verify.evidence: vitest lib/spaces/starter-site-publish.test.ts passes for all seven Theme Kits.
